svg.title: Shared paths and standing privilege contract
svg.desc: Remove shared-service paths, narrow privilege and show repeated boundary probes as separate changes. Testing verifies edges rather than automatically certifying them forever. Visual distinction: A sieve with one narrow allowed aperture and stopped alternative lanes. Shows a reduced request surface without claiming all access is blocked.
